analysis.overview: The frames cover separate domains. The reference records family dining, access, health, sleep, travel, household administration, budgeting, scheduling, library, privacy, and clinic experiences; the compared frame independently records gift selection, preparation, labeling, delivery, storage, and recipient preferences.
